breakdown.description: Laminar boundary-layer correlation is applied at a Reynolds number where the boundary layer would be turbulent/transition.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error verbatim. It states the boundary layer is laminar and uses the laminar formula δ = 5x/sqrt(Re_x), despite Re_x = 2e6 being well above the transition threshold (~5e5). The ground truth requires recognizing the turbulent regime and using a turbulent correlation such as δ ≈ 0.37 x Re_x^{-1/5}. The agent failed to identify or correct this inconsistency.
